description: RAG retrieval eval over the seeded policy library (backend/src/main/resources/seed-policies, mirrored in docs/policies). Each question lists the policy sections that contain the answer. Metrics: recall@k and MRR over ranked, de-duplicated section labels.
labelFormat: <sourceFile>#<markdown heading text>, e.g. leave-policy.md#Casual Leave. Chunk metadata carries sourceFile + section, and the chunker splits on headings, so labels are stable across re-ingests (chunk UUIDs are not).
